name: Arbiter's Gaze
source:
Arbiter's Gaze is the story of a naive schoolteacher who has to work for a summer in a mysterious island resort. Will she resist the many temptations?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/pronehouse]Patreon[/url]]
